title: Toward Valid Measurement Of (Un)fairness For Generative AI: A Proposal For Systematization Through The Lens Of Fair Equality of Chances
reasoning: The entire paper is dedicated to systematizing fairness measurement using a framework derived from political philosophy (Fair Equality of Chances). It centers its analysis on 'morally arbitrary' and 'morally decisive' factors, making ethical and moral reasoning the core component of its proposed measurement systematization.
